news.headline: RBI MPC to announce rate decision tomorrow Oct 7; 25 bps hike widely expected
news.what_happened: RBI MPC concludes its 3-day meeting (Oct 5-7). Gov. Sanjay Malhotra announces at 10 AM on Oct 7. 8 of 10 economists in Business Standard poll expect a 25 bps hike, lifting repo rate to 5.50%.
news.why_it_matters: First rate hike since Feb 2023. Driven by inflation at 4.82% — above RBI 4% target for 3 consecutive months. Markets will price in rate-sensitive sector selloff today ahead of the announcement.

news.headline: Nasdaq hits record high, +1.05%; S&P 500 +0.66% — US tech rally accelerates
news.what_happened: Nasdaq closed at 27,190.86, up 1.05%, led by Nvidia and semiconductor stocks on AI spending optimism. S&P 500 gained 0.66% to 7,773.95. September payrolls came in at just 29,000 — well below expectations — boosting equity sentiment.
news.why_it_matters: Strong US tech rally directly re-rates Indian IT valuations. Indian IT companies earning in USD benefit doubly; USD/INR flat at 96.30 so no currency drag on translation gains.

news.headline: US 10-Year Treasury yield rises to 5.311% — hawkish global macro backdrop
news.what_happened: US 10Y yield climbed ~3.4 bps to 5.311%, staying elevated as resilient US macro keeps Fed cautious on rate cuts.
news.why_it_matters: Rising US yields pull FII flows away from emerging markets like India. Combined with tomorrow's expected RBI hike = double headwind for rate-sensitive sectors including Banks, NBFCs, and Real Estate.

news.headline: FII in 7th straight session of selling — net ₹4,699 Cr sold on Oct 5
news.what_happened: FIIs sold net ₹4,699 Cr in cash markets on Oct 5, extending a 7-session selling streak totaling ₹48,387 Cr. FIIs hold 3,02,391 net short index futures contracts. DIIs bought ₹5,182 Cr, absorbing 110% of FII selling.
news.why_it_matters: Sustained FII outflows cap upside on Nifty blue chips. DII absorption is keeping the index afloat but the FII short position creates a two-way risk around tomorrow's RBI decision.

news.headline: Asian markets positive; Hang Seng +0.88%, Nikkei +0.27%; China on Golden Week holiday till Oct 8
news.what_happened: Hang Seng gained 0.88% to 24,252. Nikkei rose 0.27% to 70,136, led by Tokyo Electron (+5.5%) and SoftBank (+3.3%). Mainland China closed for Golden Week; reopens Oct 8.
news.why_it_matters: Asia risk-on supports GIFT Nifty at ~22,647 (+0.41% implied gap-up). Metals remain uncertain until China market opens Oct 8.
